input.title: Look Up Member Contact Details (E-Mail and Telephone)
input.description: Signs on to the Meridian Core Servicing Console, searches the Member Search panel by Member ID, and reads the member's contact details from the Member Profile panel on the Member Detail screen. Returns memberEmail (e-mail address) and memberPhone (telephone number). Read-only: performs a search and reads fields; changes no data and submits no transactions.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: The member number to look up, as entered in the Member ID field of the Member Search panel.

input.checkpointDescription: The Member Detail screen is displayed with a Member Profile panel showing the requested Member ID, the member's name, and the E-Mail and Telephone rows.

expectedOutcomes.description: No member exists with the supplied Member ID, so the console returns to the Member Search panel with a not-found message instead of the Member Detail screen.

expectedOutcomes.probeRationale: Alphabetic input in a numeric member number field should trigger field validation.
